info.title: XHub Key Management Contract
info.description: 开发期现有行为快照，不替换生产handler / Development snapshot of existing behavior, no runtime handler replacement.

post.summary: 创建个人Key / Create a personal key
post.description: 仅创建返回明文；默认当前用户，团队由成员关系派生；空预算仍受个人与父级预算限制。支持契约为单个对象，旧handler还接受空正文/null，未声明兼容输入不承诺严格拒绝。 / Only creation returns plaintext; defaults to current user, team derived from membership; blank budget still obeys personal and parent caps. Supported contract is one object; legacy handler also accepts empty body or null and does not strictly reject every undeclared input.

get.summary: 按权限列出Key / List keys within permission scope
get.description: scope=personal仅登录用户本人，管理员也不例外；非法分页/排序返回400，空列表总页数为1。status/expand等旧参数被忽略，不声明为有效筛选。 / scope=personal is the logged-in owner only, including admins; invalid pagination or sorting returns 400; empty results have one total page. Legacy status and expand parameters are ignored, not effective filters.

parameters.name: key_hash
parameters.description: 历史命名，实际按记录ID筛选 / Legacy name, actually filters by record ID.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: 按密钥所属用户当前团队的组织精确筛选，与权限范围及其他条件取交集；空值不限制组织，非空时无团队 Key 不匹配。 / Exact match on the key owner's current team organization; intersected with authorization and other filters. Empty means no restriction; teamless keys do not match a nonempty value.

get.summary: 查询单个Key / Read one key
get.description: 查询单个Key / Read one key

post.summary: 按正文查询单个Key / Read one key by body
post.description: 仅支持key，不支持keys数组；正文key覆盖查询参数，旧查询参数回退只记录兼容边界。 / Supports key, not a keys array; body key overrides query; legacy query fallback is a compatibility boundary.

post.summary: 更新Key并保留省略字段 / Update a key while preserving omitted fields
post.description: 返回Key对象，无data包装；不返回明文，不改变归属与历史消费。 / Returns the key object without a data envelope; no plaintext, ownership or historical spend changes.

post.summary: 删除一个或多个Key / Delete one or more keys
post.description: 先完成所有目标权限检查，再逐个删除；数据库中途失败可能部分成功，不是整批事务；重复删除404。 / Authorizes every target before deleting individually; storage failure may leave partial deletion, not a batch transaction; repeated deletion returns 404.

post.summary: 轮换成功立即撤销旧Key，仅本次返回新明文 / Rotation immediately revokes the old key and returns new plaintext once
post.description: 轮换成功立即撤销旧Key，仅本次返回新明文 / Rotation immediately revokes the old key and returns new plaintext once

post.summary: 轮换成功立即撤销旧Key，仅本次返回新明文 / Rotation immediately revokes the old key and returns new plaintext once
post.description: 轮换成功立即撤销旧Key，仅本次返回新明文 / Rotation immediately revokes the old key and returns new plaintext once

post.summary: 重置Key计费计数，不删除历史用量或改变个人预算 / Reset key spend without deleting usage history or changing personal budget
post.description: 重置Key计费计数，不删除历史用量或改变个人预算 / Reset key spend without deleting usage history or changing personal budget

post.summary: 逐项尝试，失败项跳过；updated可为0；不是原子操作，必须比较实际结果 / Per-key best effort; failures skipped, updated may be zero; non-atomic, inspect actual result

BudgetInput.description: 缺省保留（创建不设独立上限）；null/空串清空；0禁止此Key消费；字符串须为有限非负数 / Omission preserves (creation has no separate cap); null or empty string clears; zero blocks this key; strings must be finite nonnegative numbers.
